title: Ali waley jahan baithe
body:
Ali waley jahan baithe
Faqeeron ka bhi kya chahe jahan basti basa baithe ..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
ali waley jahan baithe wahi jannat bana baithe ..(2)
1. Faraze daar ho, maqtal ho, zindaan ho ke sehra ho ..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
jali ishq e ali ki shamma aur, parwaane aa baithe
2. Koi mausam, koi bhi waqt, koi bhi ilaaqa ho ..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
jahan zikr e ali chheda, wahan deewane aa baithe
3. Ali walon ka marna bhi koi marne me marna hai ..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
chale apne makaa'n se aur ali ke darr pe jaa baithe
4. Idhar rukhsat kiya sabne, udhar aae Ali lene ..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
yahan sab ro rahe the, hum wahan mehfil sajaa baithe
5. Abhi mai qabr me leta hi tha, ek noor sa phailaa ..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
meri baali pe aakar khud, Ali e murtaza baithe
6. Ali ke naam ki mehfil saji shehre khamosha me ..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
the jitne bawafa wo sab ke sab, mehfil me aa baithe
7. Nizamat ke liye maula ne khud, meesam ko bulwaya ..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
wo lehja tha ke sab daaton tale, ungli dabaa baithe
8. Ye kaun aaya ke istaqbaal me, sab ambiya utthe ..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
na baithega koi tab tak, na jab tak fatema baithe
9. Ali walo'n ke marne ka hai bus, itna sa afsana ..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
ke jaise koi masjid se azakhane me jaa baithe
10. Ali walo'n ke naaro ne, raza aisa samaa bandha ..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
ke khud maula bhi apne naam ka naara laga baithe
Ali waley jahan baithe wahi jannat bana baithe
author: Farhan Ali
